description.zh: 授权规则备注。最大500字符。
description.en: The remarks of the authorization rule. The remarks can be up to 500 characters in length.
The information about the database that runs on your server.

description.zh: 授权规则有效期结束时间（秒，时间戳格式）
description.en: The end time of the validity period of the authorization rule. Specify a UNIX timestamp representing the number of seconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC.

description.zh: 授权规则有效期开始时间（秒，时间戳格式）
description.en: The start time of the validity period of the authorization rule. Specify a UNIX timestamp representing the number of seconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC.
The information about the asset group that you want to authorize to manage.

description.zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeInstances](~~153281~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The bastion host ID.

> You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to query the bastion host ID.

description.zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。
> 地域ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见[地域和可用区](~~40654~~)。
description.en:
The region ID of the bastion host.

> For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

description.zh: 授权规则名称。最大128字符。
description.en: The name of the authorization rule. The name can be up to 128 characters in length.
An array that consists of user group IDs.
An array that consists of user IDs.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost create-rule --instance-id bastionhost-cn-5yd2ymfsa0e --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --rule-name rule --comment comment --effective-start-time 1669630029 --effective-end-time 1672502400 --user-ids 1 --user-group-ids 1 --hosts '[{"HostId":"1","HostAccountIds":["1"]}]' --databases '[{"DatabaseId":"2","DatabaseAccountIds":["4"]}]' --host-groups '[{"HostGroupId":"3","HostAccountNames":["root"]}]' --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost CreateRule --region cn-hangzhou --Comment comment --UserIds.1 1 --InstanceId 'bastionhost-cn-5yd2ymfsa0e' --Databases.1.DatabaseId 2 --Hosts.1.HostAccountIds.1 1 --Hosts.1.HostId 1 --Databases.1.DatabaseAccountIds.1 4 --EffectiveEndTime 1672502400 --EffectiveStartTime 1669630029 --UserGroupIds.1 1 --HostGroups.1.HostGroupId 3 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --HostGroups.1.HostAccountNames.1 root --RuleName rule --method POST --force
